newsitem.title: GERMANY: British helicopter crashes, pilot dies in Germany.
newsitem.headline: British helicopter crashes, pilot dies in Germany.

text.p: The pilot of a British military helicopter that crashed near the Bavarian village of Urspring died of his injuries in hospital on Sunday, German police said.
Seven other people who had also been in the helicopter when it crashed on Saturday evening were released from hospital after checks, a spokesman for British Forces in Germany said.
Police said that as the Royal Air Force Puma helicopter came down part of a tree fell heavily on the cockpit. The cause of the crash was still not known.
Five passengers, a British army officer and four soldiers, and three crew members were in the helicopter when it crashed as it was coming in to land near the city of Murnau.
The helicopter was based at RAF Laarbruch in North-Rhine-Westphalia and had been supporting a RAF winter training exercise in the Murnau area.
